scope: Current revision: four original procedural Three.js exhibits, supported by existing original AI raster concept images and HTML fallbacks. No historical film is a current production asset.
commercial_status: Original fictional concept cases, not clients, commissions, delivered products or commercial results.

production.image_mode: generate; one subsequent precise-object edit for the branding image
production.encoding: FFmpeg JPEG encoding from selected PNG masters at original resolution; no visual editing in Python and no upscaling
production.model_source: Original procedural JavaScript geometry in src/scene-objects.js; not generated meshes or raster-to-3D conversions

assets.prompt_summary: FORMA luxury Italian coffee identity: tactile yellow bag, black typography, espresso, travertine and print. Edit removes only all small contact, address and year microcopy, retaining FORMA and CAFFÈ CONTEMPORANEO.
assets.scene_role: Raster image in the FORMA concept dialog and HTML fallback. Coffee and packaging in the image are not modeled; the live branding scene uses the separate original Space compass model.
assets.concept_status: Illustrative fictional coffee identity, not a client or commission.

assets.prompt_summary: Premium architectural editorial image of a contemporary Italian facade with pale travertine, a projecting rectangular upper volume, precise black metal glazing, pale blue sky and crisp natural shadows. Plausible built geometry, no people, cars, logos, lettering or watermarks.
assets.scene_role: Raster architecture image within original desktop/mobile interface textures, concept dialog and HTML fallback; the building is not a mesh.
assets.concept_status: Illustrative fictional architecture case, not a photographed client building or a delivered website.

assets.prompt_summary: Photoreal luxury ORA fragrance campaign: thick clear square glass bottle, amber liquid, dark water and black studio. The only product typography is ORA and EAU DE PARFUM.
assets.scene_role: Raster product artwork in the ORA concept dialog and HTML fallback. The live scene uses an independently built original fragrance model; it is not the photograph converted to a mesh or a simulated fluid film.
assets.concept_status: Illustrative fictional fragrance visual, not a real product commission or a rendered CGI film.

assets.prompt_summary: Original culture and fashion campaign background: large electric-yellow silk installation sweeping diagonally across black space in three physically plausible architectural folds, textile detail and crisp white optical light shafts. Entirely without people, products, logos, text or watermarks.
assets.scene_role: Raster campaign image in the SPAZIO concept dialog and HTML fallback. The live scene uses an independent typographic poster and geometric ribbons, not a cloth simulation of the image.
assets.concept_status: Illustrative fictional cultural campaign, not an event client or commissioned advertisement.

actual_geometry: Four separate beveled components of the Space compass mark, plus identity card and colour samples
Desktop and mobile web interface surfaces and a navigation module with physical depth
Original ORA bottle body, amber content, shoulder, collar, pump, separate cap, label and display base
Typographic campaign poster and three geometric ribbons
Room floor, environment, lights and perspective camera
not_modeled: Coffee or its packaging shown in the raster image
Water or physically simulated fragrance fluid
runtime.motion: Native-scroll camera and absolute station poses, timed mark assembly/reassembly, layered interface motion, cap reveal and geometric ribbon choreography. Restrained fine-pointer response; no wheel or touch hijacking.
runtime.fallback: Semantic HTML content and original raster images remain available without WebGL or JavaScript. Reduced motion and SaveData retain the static presentation.
runtime.performance_claim: No current browser timing, frame-rate, physical-iPhone or 4K/60 fps certification. Configured render cadence is not a measured frame rate.
runtime.model_limits: Original illustrative models, not CAD-accurate commercial products. Amber content is a mesh; ribbons are geometry rather than fluid or cloth simulations. The photo and live fragrance model are distinct original assets.
runtime.semantic_content: HTML titles, service descriptions and actions remain readable during camera transitions; no chapter-copy opacity removal.
runtime.mobile_layout: Below 901px, a measured 4:3 HTML slot and fixed-canvas clipping follow native scroll; chapter backgrounds retain text contrast. Numeric clipping checks passed; current browser visual verification was unavailable.

local_video_attempt.workflow: Video Non Higgsfield / local ComfyUI and LTX
local_video_attempt.reason: Stopped before frame generation when available memory reached approximately 2.51 GiB, below the configured 3 GiB threshold.

horizon.note: Current models, surfaces and interactions are original project resources. No Horizon source or asset is distributed.

service_content.projects_and_funding: General project development and opportunity research for companies, APS and ASD. No open call, eligibility decision or funding guarantee is claimed.
